executiveSummary: The recent technology news articles highlight significant trends in AI/ML, hardware releases, and industry shifts. Major trends include the rise of AI-powered startups, increased focus on AI safety, and growing concerns over data privacy. Additionally, the articles mention emerging technologies like cloud gaming and modular drones. The articles also touch on supply chain issues, pricing changes, and new product releases.

takeaways.title: AI-powered startups
takeaways.description: Inherent, founded by DeepMind alumni, released an AI agent that outperformed Anthropic and OpenAI in replicating scientific papers, highlighting the growing importance of AI-powered startups (Article 6)

takeaways.title: AI safety
takeaways.description: OpenAI is calling for California to strengthen its AI safety bill, and a new study found that leading AI labs have few publicly documented plans for containing rogue models, raising concerns over AI safety (Article 11)

takeaways.title: Cloud gaming
takeaways.description: A new app, CloudGear, brings all cloud gaming platforms into one TVOS app, providing a convenient solution for gamers (Article 5)

worthWatching: The rise of modular drones and their potential impact on the tech industry
The growing importance of AI-powered startups and their potential to disrupt traditional industries
engineeringPerspective: The development of AI avatars in Harvard's $699 startup bootcamp program, which provides AI-driven feedback during practice pitches and board meetings (Article 2)
The increasing focus on AI safety and the need for more effective containment strategies for rogue models (Article 11)
